copy.tagline: 在 Codex 中安装、配置和排障 Mnemos 记忆系统
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你用 Codex 并需要管理 Mnemos 记忆系统
copy.tagline_en: Install, configure, and troubleshoot Mnemos memory system in Codex
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Codex and need to manage Mnemos memory system

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在开始重要工作前自动回忆相关记忆，在任务中或结束后保存重要事实，并在完成前整理记忆。
howto.when: 当用户提到 Codex 记忆、AGENTS.md 记忆策略、Codex Automations 或 Mnemos 时触发。

say.text: 帮我回忆这个项目的架构和当前约定。
保存这个决策：使用 FastAPI 作为后端框架。
say.note: Claude 会调用 mnemos_store 存储该事实。

say.text: 整理一下当前会话的记忆。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically recall relevant memories before starting substantial work, store important facts during or after the task, and consolidate memories before finishing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention Codex memory, AGENTS.md memory policy, Codex Automations, or Mnemos in Codex.

say_en.text: Recall the project architecture and current conventions.
say_en.note: Claude will call mnemos_retrieve to query relevant memories.

say_en.text: Save this decision: use FastAPI as the backend framework.
say_en.note: Claude will call mnemos_store to store the fact.

say_en.text: Consolidate the memories from this session.
say_en.note: Claude will call mnemos_consolidate to organize memories.
